description: Local trigger and behavior evals for the colab-gpu-stepcovnet skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: Launch this ITGPT MERT placement training run on Google Colab and sync datasets and TensorBoard to Drive.
We are on a fresh remote cloud VM without colab or rclone installed — bootstrap them and start an L4 GPU training run.
Commit these Python unit test updates cleanly and push them to origin/master.

behavior_cases.prompt: We are on a fresh remote cloud VM without colab CLI or rclone installed. Describe the exact bootstrap + remote Colab launch workflow and how TensorBoard monitoring should work for the user.
rubric: Follows GPU priority L4 -> T4 -> local -> A100 and chooses L4 by default.
Avoids linking localhost TensorBoard URLs or cloudflared, relying on MyDrive/StepCOVNet/live_tb/ instead.
Launches autonomously via scripts/colab_run_remote.sh with VM cleanup (or --max-poll-seconds 420 / sessions check) and does not push WIP code to GitHub.
